title: UTA-wave 1.1.10 Startup Crash & Theme Fix
changelog:
• Fixed launch crash on Android 8.0+ by resolving theme XML parent syntax and removing incompatible windowLightNavigationBar attributes
• Resolved edge-to-edge system bar runtime conflicts on app initialization
• Added startup splash watchdog and failsafe dismiss mechanism ensuring instantaneous entry to Home screen
• Added tap-to-dismiss gesture on opening splash animation
• Hardened display refresh rate controller with runtime error guard
